name: ax-design-system
description: AX 디자인시스템 — 토큰 계약 + 헤드리스 바인딩 스타일 층

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run lint:contract && npm run build:react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ax/react && npm run typecheck -w @ax/storybook
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run build:registry && npm run build -w @ax/playground
scripts.build-storybook: npm run build-storybook -w @ax/storybook && npm run build:registry && cp -R registry/r apps/storybook/storybook-static/
